as_told.title: Hieroglyphics test run by Amelia's spelling therapist and babysitter

plain: A mother named Mora says that her daughter Amelia, a girl who communicates by typing and who appears in a documentary series called The Telepathy Tapes, read and translated Hebrew she had never been taught, and later recognized ancient Egyptian hieroglyphics she had never seen. When Mora asked who taught her Hebrew, she says, Amelia typed "the rabbi." The filmmaker Ky Dickens tells it a little differently, saying the hieroglyphics test was done by Amelia's spelling therapist and babysitter, and the story is told because it would suggest the girl knows things she could not have learned in the usual way.
